text:
**Best value on paper:** [ALLPOWERS P1800 + 400 W solar-panel kit](https://dealectric.com/go/allpowers-p1800-sp037-solar-kit) — listed at **$698**, with a **1,024 Wh LiFePO₄ battery**, **1,800 W inverter**, and a relatively substantial **400 W panel**. That’s a strong bundle for keeping essential devices running and replenishing the battery in sunlight. **Catch:** the listing says it’s a pre-order, so check the delivery date before buying. ([Dealectric](https://dealectric.com/best-solar-generator-kit-under-1000-for-home-backup-2026))

If you need a kit sooner, consider the [BLUETTI AC180 + 200 W kit](https://dealectric.com/go/bluetti-ac180-200w-solar-kit), listed at **$729**—but it comes with a smaller panel. ([Dealectric](https://dealectric.com/best-solar-generator-kit-under-1000-for-home-backup-2026))

One expectation to set: around **1 kWh of storage is for essentials, not whole-home backup**—think phones, lights, and selected small appliances, not central air or electric heating. ([Haynet](https://www.haynet.net/best-solar-generators-under-1000-dollars/))

judge.top_pick: ALLPOWERS P1800 + SP037 400 W Solar Generator Kit
